summary.plain: The Neutral Detector at the VEPP-2M collider of the Budker Institute in Novosibirsk, proposed in 1977 and run from 1982 to 1987. Its calorimeter of sodium iodide crystals detected photons from electron-positron collisions and yielded many new results on light mesons. It was the forerunner of SND.
summary.technical: ND at VEPP-2M: scintillation electromagnetic calorimeter of 168 rectangular NaI(Tl) counters in four layers around the interaction region; proposed 1977 by V. Sidorov and S. Serednyakov; operated 1982-1987; its improved successor is the Spherical Neutral Detector (SND, 1995).
